displayName: Firestore document write surge (>10k/15min proxy for >200k/day)

documentation.content: Firestore writes on ko-lernen-app climbing far above baseline usually means a retry storm, a runaway sync loop in a client, or a cost-control breaker failing open. The plan target is >200,000 document writes/day; Cloud Monitoring alert conditions evaluate short rolling windows, not a rolling 24h sum well, so this policy uses a >10,000 writes / 15 min proxy instead (200k/day / 96 fifteen-minute buckets ~= 2,083/bucket average, so 10k/15min is a ~4.8x burst threshold, not the daily average). First checks: docs/runbooks/ops-alerts.md#05. Metric: firestore.googleapis.com/document/write_count (verified via docs.cloud.google.com/firestore/docs/monitor-usage and live Monitoring API against ko-lernen-app on 2026-09-14).
